reason: I'd probably use the free first visit, but $16 on a Saturday for one toddler is a lot when the library and parks are free, and I'll be chasing my kid the whole time so the coffee barely matters. I wouldn't pay again after that unless it clearly beat the free options.
objection: I only go on weekends, which is the pricier rate, and I'd be up chasing my toddler instead of sitting and drinking coffee. It doesn't feel worth $16 a pop.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend price around $10 or a weekend rate that matches weekdays, or a real bargain on the 5-visit pack.
